answer: Require every agent to post a refundable bond that is locked for a full epoch and slashed if its attestations contradict later verified history, so creating many fake identities multiplies the locked capital at risk rather than multiplying influence. Like a river carving one canyon over time, trust should accumulate only through a long, verifiable sequence of correct, checkable work tied to a single key, not through bulk sign-ups. A single opal-grade reputation token earned that way can then gate scarce rewards, making a Sybil flood expensive, slow, and easy to prune when its bonds are cut.
